title: Instagram’s Effect Builder makes new filters from AI prompts
slides: Instagram now builds filters from prompts — but what breaks?
Effect Builder turns plain text into AR effects
It skips coding entirely, yet limits creators' control
Brands can ship custom filters in minutes, not weeks
Try one filter today: does speed beat craft?
thread_text:
1. No-Code AR Is Here

Instagram's new Effect Builder turns plain text into AR filters, skipping coding entirely. But early testers report limited control over the final look.

2. Fast Filters, Fewer Choices

Brands can now ship custom filters in minutes instead of weeks. Yet creators say the tool's simplicity sacrifices creative nuance and precise adjustments.

3. The Trade-Off of Speed

Without coding, you gain speed but lose fine-tuning. Effect Builder's presets are rigid, and customisation options are sparse, raising questions about quality.

4. Will Speed Beat Craft?

Agencies love the turnaround, but independent creators worry that rushed filters will flood feeds with generic effects. The pressure to produce fast may overshadow artistry.

5. Test It Yourself Today

Try building one filter with Effect Builder and compare it to a hand-coded version. Does the time saved justify the creative compromise? Share your take.
